other_conditions: Applicant must be a native of Madhya Pradesh
Applicant must not be a taxpayer
Applicant must not have previously taken the benefit of Teerth Darshan Yojna

Applicant must be physically and mentally fit and free from listed infectious diseases (TB, congestive cardiac, obstructive respiratory disease, coronary insufficiency, coronary thrombosis, mental illness, leprosy, etc.)
If a husband and wife travel together, the spouse can accompany even if below the age limit provided the other spouse is eligible
Group applications must not exceed 25 persons, with the group head as the main applicant
Providing false information may lead to loss of benefits
A medical certificate confirming fitness is mandatory
Single pilgrims above 65 years and disabled citizens (≥60% disability) may be entitled to a caretaker/helper
benefits_summary: One‑time free pilgrimage travel for senior citizens of Madhya Pradesh, covering train, accommodation, meals and related facilities.
documents_required: Medical certificate confirming physical and mental fitness
Identity proof (Aadhaar Card or Voter Card)
